text: This solution, Sovereign Risk Transfer Scheme Development in Fiji addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Republic of Fiji between Government of Fiji, Reserve Bank of Fiji (RBF), World Bank Group, International Finance Corporation (IFC), and Willis Towers Watson (WTW). The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
